apps.localizedDescription:
DolphiniOS:

DolphiniOS is a port of the Dolphin Emulator to iOS and iPadOS. For installation instructions and downloads, check our website.

This is the repository for the new DolphiniOS codebase.

JIT on iOS 26 (Trusted Execution Monitor):

iCube runs the JIT recompiler again on iOS 26. TXM will not execute a freshly written code page until a debugger has written to that page, so iCube asks an attached broker to touch every page of its 288 MB code region once at startup. After that the broker can detach and the region stays usable for the life of the process.

• Users: see JIT & Performance for how to turn it on with StikDebug, what to expect without it, and troubleshooting.
